The exact required test_auth_required_survives_restart_and_resumes_after_manual_mock_login executes apply_mock to AUTH_REQUIRED with zero requests, closes/reopens SQLite/API, signs in using a real headless persistent context, closes and reopens that exact profile, asserts saved mock_session cookie, queues a separate mock-run and executes the real worker to CONFIRMED and one local receipt. from datetime import datetime, timezone
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
from sqlalchemy import select, update
import httpx
from fixtures.mock_server import fixture_server
from services.discovery.pipeline import discover
from services.documents.generate import prepare
from services.applications.mock_adapter import apply_mock

from packages.persistence import models as m
from tests.integration.test_application_pipeline import ApplicationPipelineTests

print('PROBE_START_UTC', datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), flush=True)
case = ApplicationPipelineTests('test_mock_actions_are_profile_scoped')
case.setUp()
closures = []
def observe(context):
    record = {'closed': False, 'disconnected': False}
    context.on('close', lambda *_: record.update(closed=True))
    context.browser.on('disconnected', lambda *_: record.update(disconnected=True))
    closures.append(record)
try:
    with fixture_server() as origin:
        job = next(row for row in case.store.jobs('fixture') if row['requisition'] == 'B')
        other_id = prepare(case.store, job['id'], 'other', case.root)
        for app_id in (case.application_id, other_id):
            route_id = case.store.application(app_id)['route_id']
            with case.store.engine.begin() as connection:
                requisition = connection.execute(select(m.routes.c.requisition).where(m.routes.c.id == route_id)).scalar_one()
                connection.execute(update(m.routes).where(m.routes.c.id == route_id).values(url=f'{origin}/ats/apply/{requisition}?auth_expired=true'))
        first_dir = case.root / case.application_id / 'browser-profile'
        other_dir = case.root / other_id / 'browser-profile'
        assert first_dir != other_dir
        with sync_playwright() as pw:
            context = pw.chromium.launch_persistent_context(str(first_dir), headless=True, timeout=15000)
            try:
                observe(context)
                page = context.new_page()
                page.set_default_timeout(5000)
                page.goto(origin + '/ats/login/B', timeout=5000)
                page.get_by_label('Fixture username', exact=True).fill('fixture-user')
                page.get_by_label('Fixture password', exact=True).fill('fixture-password')
                page.get_by_role('button', name='Sign in', exact=True).click()
                page.wait_for_url('**/ats/apply/**')
                assert any(c['name'] == 'mock_session' for c in context.cookies(origin))
                page.locator('[name="email"]').fill('invalid-email')
                assert page.locator('[name="email"]').evaluate('el => el.validity.typeMismatch')
                assert not page.locator('form').evaluate('form => form.checkValidity()')
                page.get_by_role('button', name='Review application', exact=True).click()
                assert httpx.get(origin + '/_test/request-counts', trust_env=False).json() == {'review': 0, 'submit': 0}
                print('INVALID_FORM_NATIVE_VALIDITY_AND_NO_POST observed', flush=True)
            finally:
                context.close()
            assert closures[-1] == {'closed': True, 'disconnected': True}
            context = pw.chromium.launch_persistent_context(str(other_dir), headless=True, timeout=15000)
            try:
                observe(context)
                assert not any(c['name'] == 'mock_session' for c in context.cookies(origin))
                page = context.new_page()
                page.goto(origin + '/ats/apply/B?auth_expired=true', timeout=5000)
                assert page.locator('[data-auth-required="true"]').count() == 1
            finally:
                context.close()
            assert closures[-1] == {'closed': True, 'disconnected': True}
            context = pw.chromium.launch_persistent_context(str(first_dir), headless=True, timeout=15000)
            try:
                observe(context)
                assert any(c['name'] == 'mock_session' for c in context.cookies(origin))
            finally:
                context.close()
            assert closures[-1] == {'closed': True, 'disconnected': True}
        assert all(item == {'closed': True, 'disconnected': True} for item in closures)
        print('OWNED_CONTEXT_CLEANUP', len(closures), 'real close and browser disconnected events; no termination used', flush=True)
        assert apply_mock(case.store, other_id, origin, case.root, submit=True)['state'] == 'AUTH_REQUIRED'
        assert httpx.get(origin + '/_test/request-counts', trust_env=False).json() == {'review': 0, 'submit': 0}
        assert apply_mock(case.store, case.application_id, origin, case.root, submit=False)['state'] == 'DRY_RUN_COMPLETE'
        assert httpx.get(origin + '/_test/request-counts', trust_env=False).json() == {'review': 1, 'submit': 0}
        print('PROFILE_ISOLATION_AND_AUTHENTICATED_REOPEN_PRODUCT_RESUME observed; other AUTH_REQUIRED, own DRY_RUN_COMPLETE, submit=0', flush=True)
finally:
    case.tearDown()
print('PROBE_END_UTC', datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), flush=True)
